response.original_title: The Best Football Funnies Ever II
response.overview: 'The Best Football Funnies Ever II' is another hysterical compilation of some of the funniest mishaps by some of the sport's biggest names. See the game's greats get it all wrong over and over again when the cameras are on them. With all the new footage taken from across Europe's top leagues from the Premier League to the Bundesliga there is no hiding place as we reveal some of the biggest mishaps the game has ever seen.
response.title: The Best Football Funnies Ever II
